text:
Alex K: Quick sync — we need a tiny convention for request/response schema before the API launch. Proposed: top-level request_id + trace_id, a flat metadata block with customer_id & tenant, and flat token usage fields tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, tokens_total. Thoughts?

Sana Patel: +1 for flat fields. Nested usage paths (usage.tokens.prompt) make metrics + prometheus mapping annoying. prefer snake_case flat: tokens_prompt etc.

Maria G: Docs + SDKs can map either way, but flat reduces churn. Also surface model_version and model_variant (for rollouts).

Rajiv Menon: From runtime side we need trace propagation: trace_id required, span_id optional. Also we should emit latency_ms split: queue_ms, compute_ms, network_ms. Helps SLO debugging.

Taylor H: For function/tool calling, return a function_call object: name, arguments (string or JSON string), and an optional structured_schema_id field referencing the output schema. Avoid binary or opaque blobs.

devex-bot: Reminder: if we change shapes, SDKs must continue to parse old fields for a deprecation window. :robot_face:

Sana Patel: Acceptance criteria idea: schema ADR, examples for chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool-calls; SDK parsing unit tests; CI schema validation; one internal integration test.

Maria G: sample minimal chat response (for docs):
```json
{
  "request_id": "r_123456",
  "trace_id": "t_abcd-ef01",
  "model": "redwood-7b-v2",
  "model_variant": "quant-8",
  "tokens_prompt": 34,
  "tokens_completion": 166,
  "tokens_total": 200,
  "queue_ms": 12,
  "compute_ms": 95,
  "network_ms": 13,
  "latency_ms": 120,
  "response": { "content": "Hey! here's the answer..." }
}
```

Rajiv Menon: Also include routed_model and fallback_model fields when we reroute or fall back. That makes incident triage simpler.

Alex K: Launch prioritization: mandatory for MVP = request_id + trace_id + tokens_* + model/model_variant + basic latency fields + function_call shape for tooling. Follow-ups = structured_schema registry, per-token-level cost breakdown, richer metadata.

Taylor H: I'll create a PR checklist for SDK + docs + runtime to cover these.

Sana Patel: I'll own the ticket and coordinate eng/runtime + devex + docs. Will add migration/deprecation plan.

Alex K: thanks. @devex-bot can you create an epic?

devex-bot: Created epic EPIC-981: schema-conventions (https://redwood.example/EPIC-981)

Taylor H: One more ask — include a trace_sample_rate field opt-in for high-volume customers so we can avoid flooding traces.

Rajiv Menon: good call. Add trace_sample_rate as optional in request metadata.

Alex K: Great. We'll finalize ADR by EOW and kick off SDK PRs next week.
